QuestInfo.name: Asking After Mrs. Ming Ming, the Town Resident.
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on #b#p203##k, a resident of the town. Let's go see how #p203# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p203#, a resident of #m10001000#. I'm glad to see she's doing well!

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p203#, one of #m10001000#'s residents, is doing lately. It would be wonderful if you could check on her for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Welcome, #h0#. It's so lovely to see you again. Me? Oh, I'm doing just fine. Except for being rather busy with the preparations for the town festival, that is.
1.1: I'm truly delighted because it feels like #m10001000# has become much more lively since you became a resident here. Well, I must get back to work now. Have a wonderful day, #h0#!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
